messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: If you or your child takes too much Adderall, call your healthcare provider or the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
Go to the nearest hospital emergency room right away.
An overdose of Adderall could be fatal.
Overdose symptoms may include restlessness.
Overdose symptoms may include tremor.
Overdose symptoms may include muscle twitches.
Overdose symptoms may include rapid breathing.
Overdose symptoms may include confusion.
Overdose symptoms may include hallucinations.
Overdose symptoms may include panic.
Overdose symptoms may include aggressiveness.
Overdose symptoms may include muscle pain or weakness.
Overdose symptoms may include dark colored urine.
These symptoms may be followed by depression and tiredness.
Other symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, uneven heartbeats, feeling light-headed, fainting, seizure, or coma.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has overdose risk", "could be fatal"]

The relation 'has overdose risk' in the triplet is defined as 'An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
